title: Isolate blocked stdin cancellation from prompt preprocessing
notes: The cancellation timing assertion includes the cost of redacting a megabyte before the runner starts. Under contention it can exceed the limit even when supervision returns the correct outcome.
done_when: Exercise a started process with unread stdin and keep attempt outcome checks independent of payload size.
result: Isolate blocked stdin cancellation from prompt preprocessing
evidence: The attempt outcome and unread-stdin process tests passed two race-enabled runs. codeality-go gate passed.
